subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: PER.VT.U.FUND.------PROG.CONT.
description: Second diagram on page 368 (R(AS)CM(II)-12). The crossing diagrams how the concept of perceived-vibrational-universe-fundamental structurally meets progressional-continuance: (C)PER-VT-U-FUND (the concept of perceived vibrational universe fundamental) crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). PER-VT-U-FUND sits on the left with the subject-arrow; PROJ-DYM (projectional dynamics) rises from the main line, and AFI (affinity insight) branches from PROJ-DYM at upper-left. TRS (transition) branches from the main line; PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars) hangs from TRS and carries two lines: one to C-INFO (composite information), from which SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) drops, and one to MT-INFO (multi-information), from which POL-DYM (political dynamics) drops. PROG-CONT sits at upper-right as partner-axis.
